name: Hybrid Voxel Rendering (Mesh/Splatting)
definition: A rendering strategy that uses OpenGL splatting (rendering quads/points with ray-AABB testing in a fragment shader) for distant voxels and mesh rendering for nearby voxels to reduce vertex count while maintaining quality, addressing the performance problem of slow fragment shaders with nearby voxels.
summary: Hybrid Voxel Rendering combines OpenGL splatting for distant voxels with mesh rendering for nearby ones to reduce vertex count and overcome the slow fragment shader performance of pure splatting methods.
